findings.reason: §27 must add `tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py` (its golden literal) to its write paths, or the deliverable's new `local_lane` field and its own gate are in direct conflict.
findings.text: the section's done-when requires "The test files importing `lane_context.py` or `promotion.py` show no added failure against the base revision", but adding `expected_wait_profile_age_s` to `local_lane` changes the rendered picker state that `tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py:38` pins byte for byte (`GOLDEN_STATE`, compared with `==` at line 212), and that file is not among §27's declared write paths, so the node cannot satisfy its own done-when without an out-of-scope edit

findings.reason: the done-when's negative control patches `run_time_profile` to raise, so a head that rebuilt on the moved stamp fails the first test before the control even runs and the node self-corrects; naming the read helper is a clarity edit, not a change to the contract.
findings.text: the deliverable says `_cached_run_time_profile` "serves the last persisted profile for the project when the stamp has moved" but names only `capabilities.cached_pick_input_rekeyed` as the cache access, and that function returns the stored value only when `entry["key"]` equals the current stamp (`reckon/capabilities.py:1314`), so on a moved stamp it rebuilds; the moved-stamp serve needs a direct read of the cache file via the public `capabilities.pick_input_cache_path` (reckon/capabilities.py:1193), which the section does not name

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `docs/research/the-pick-state-render-is-slow-because.html` exists (commit 06cfdc898) and carries the 99.5%/41.0%/15.31% figures; `_cached_run_time_profile` (`reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:570`), `_expected_wait` (:616), `local_lane` (:690), `capabilities.cached_pick_input_rekeyed` (`reckon/capabilities.py:1285`), `reckon/crew/promotion.py`, the glossary `_GLOSSARY` (`reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py:34`), the emitted `timeout in pick:state-render` string (`reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:500`; asserted at `tests/test_a_pick_names_its_slow_stage.py:328`) and `jev-learns-from-its-routes#s5` all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §27's done-when requires the test files importing `lane_context.py` or `promotion.py` to show no added failure, but the new `local_lane` field trips a byte-exact golden in a test file outside §27's write paths.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate is the new test `tests/test_a_pick_never_rebuilds_a_profile.py` and the existing suite, all on committed paths; no session scratchpad or node-local temporary is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers reach the section; `expected_wait_profile_age_s` and `tests/test_a_pick_never_rebuilds_a_profile.py` are named by what they do.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass on the three checks — the stated root cause (a promotion moves the ledger stamp and the next pick rebuilds the profile synchronously) matches the cited evidence (99.5% of read time in the slow renders; the cache is keyed on the stamp and the calendar day), the mechanism (promotion refreshes and persists, the pick serves) produces the done-when, and the caller is named (promotion's ledger append). The named writer's read path is under-specified for the moved-stamp case, but the done-when's raising-`run_time_profile` arm catches a literal writer-routed read, so it is not a defect that would send a node down a wrong path.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the section's one deliverable is that a pick serves a published profile rather than rebuilding one; the refresh hook, the 24 h bound and the age figure are facets of that one contract, not separable deliverables.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §27's `plan-section-depends-on` entry names `lane-and-model-routing#s25` (landed, commit 06cfdc898) and `jev-learns-from-its-routes#s5` (`docs/plans/jev-learns-from-its-routes.html:231`), and §5's own write paths name `reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py` and `reckon/crew/picker/prompts.py`, which is exactly the pair the change added to §27's paths.
